$comment: United Arab Emirates - Wave 3. First RTL market, so this pack is the one
that proves the layout work. Data residency is a legal requirement here,
Cutoff caveat: Gulf populations have very high T2D prevalence, but the
evidence for which anthropometric cutoffs apply is genuinely mixed - they
are neither clearly Asian-Pacific nor clearly European. Left at Western
defaults with validation_status 'not_validated', which forces the
clinical-score fallback. Do not guess this one; it needs local data.

prevalence_prior.source: IDF Diabetes Atlas - MENA region has among the highest prevalence globally

risk_model.$note: No local validation set identified. Until one exists this market must run clinical-score-only, per PRD 7.4b.

food.composition_source: FAO/INFOODS regional tables - expect to build our own
food.$note: MENA image data is the thinnest of any wave. Cheapest path per PRD 17.4c: Open Food Facts for packaged goods + regional table for staples + VLM fallback, then let user corrections build the dataset.

ramadan.$safety: Highest-usage market for this mode. Safety card is mandatory, not optional.

regulatory.regime: UAE MOHAP registration for health apps; UAE data protection law
regulatory.notes: Data residency may be legally required (Saudi PDPL is stricter still). me-central is not optional here.
